text: R19-12. **A public (anonymous) actor is the documented way to need no Keycloak, and it still cannot be added (R16-1 reproduced).** The earlier note in item 8 ("no way to get a login without a mapped principal ...") missed it: `accesspoint.md` "Anonymous vs Authenticated Behaviour" says an actor with `anonymous = true` and no principal gets no realm/client and its calls need no token; a mapped principal makes the flag useless (Customer and Admin both have `anonymous=true` stored, ignored). Built on branch `guest-actor` (commit "WIP: public Guest actor"): actor `Guest` (HUMAN, anonymous, no principal), unmapped-free read-only TO `GuestProductInfo` (name, sku, price, unit, description, ...), access `products` (DERIVED `Product!filter(p | p.active)`), `fill`; the model validates (esm, ui, transform) and `./judo.sh generate` works, but `./judo.sh build -i` fails in `webshop__admin` at `pnpm run format`: `import type { CsvFile, CsvFile, CsvFileStored, CsvFileStored }` (duplicate declarations in `dialogs/*/customization.ts`; `UiPageHelper.getApiImportsForPage` returns the class type twice). Same as R16-1: any third actor. Main was restored (no Guest). Catalog "dual-actor-frontend-architecture.md" promises three actors work; it does not.
note: Covered already: (a) mapped TO auto members, (b) managed refused on anonymous actor, (c) MenuItemAccess. Check (d) judo.sh build -i vs -M -B half state, and the claim that the catalog promises three actors.

text: R19-16. **What was built instead of the public actor:** the documented `supportGuestAccess` flag of the Customer actor (`update webshop::Customer -s supportGuestAccess=true`; a property of the actor, found with `update --schema`; catalog: extension-points.md "Guest Page") and a registered guest page (`custom/hooks/registerGuestPage.tsx`): an unauthenticated visitor of `/webshop/Customer/` sees the shop name and a Login / Register button (Keycloak), no data. It shows no products: public product data needs a backend access of an anonymous actor (R19-12). Checked in the browser (guest page shown, admin login lands on the Dashboard through `AdminHome`). The base route to a public actor is not possible without that actor.

R19-17  (a) after adding an actor `./judo.sh generate` did not add the module to `application/frontend-react/pom.xml`, `e2e/pom.xml`, `karaf-features/pom.xml` + `feature.xml`: copied from the branch where it had; the full `build -i` (not `-f`) is needed to get the new module; (b) the Guest REST path is `/api/webshop/Guest/Guest/products/~list` (no token, 200 with no login: checked); (c) `./judo.sh generate` overwrites a changed `src/custom/application-customizer.tsx` of a NEW actor frontend (it kept the Customer one); only run `build -i` after editing; (d) the first load of an app takes about 10 s (the page shows "Hello!" or blank until the bundle and services are ready), look twice before judging.
note: (a) generate does not add a new actor module to frontend-react/pom.xml, e2e/pom.xml, karaf-features pom + feature.xml; (b) anonymous actor REST path /api/<model>/<Actor>/<Actor>/<access>/~list without token; (c) generate overwrites src/custom/application-customizer.tsx of a NEW actor frontend (catalog frontend/README.md says src/custom is written by the build); (d) first load ~10 s; root route / is a Karaf page with no documented override. Trace judo.sh.hbs, the esm generator maven plugin and the fullstack/ui-react templates.
